source: live directory listing of ~/.config/opencode/ on 2026-10-07, plus https://opencode.ai/docs/skills/ discovery paths

entities.name: global opencode config dir
entities.description: ~/.config/opencode - holds opencode.jsonc (MCP servers incl. graph-memory); symlinks to AGENTS.md and three harness docs (HARNESS-AUDIT.md, HARNESS-CONTRACT.md, HARNESS-ROADMAP.md - not the HARNESS-METRICS.md or HARNESS-PHASE-*-VALIDATION.md files); and skills/ + commands/ symlinks. grill-me and write-prd resolve into the harness repo, graph-memory resolves into opencode-config

entities.name: OpenCode skill discovery
entities.description: Skills load only from ~/.config/opencode/skills/<name>/SKILL.md, .opencode/skills/, or the ~/.claude and ~/.agents equivalents; a repo's own skills/ or commands/ directory is NOT discovered

entities.name: graph-memory skill
entities.description: SKILL.md in the opencode-config repo documenting the Extract-Resolve-Assemble-Query loop, provenance rules, and safety rails
